reports.title: Movement key pressed in same tick as pause still moves player
reports.observed: In the tick where pause and a movement key are pressed together (pause first), the game pauses but the player still moves; events show [pause, move].
reports.expected: Pause takes effect immediately; the rest of that tick's input is ignored and nothing moves.

value.notes: Budget is nearly spent, so I'm stopping here. Confirmed one bug: a movement key pressed in the same tick as pause still moves the player. Seed 1, single token 'pause+right' from the start moves the player from (1,1) to (2,1) while the game ends paused, with events [pause,move]. Per section 2 and section 7, pause is pressed first, so the rest of that tick's input must be ignored and the player should stay at (1,1). Replay confirmed this, and one token is already minimal. Not yet tested: pause+dash, pause+use on the lever, HUD-vs-state checks, spikes, timer bonus, and dialog buttons.

reports.title: Movement key pressed in same tick after pause still moves player
reports.observed: With pause pressed before right in the same tick, the game pauses but the player still moves from (1,1) to (2,1). Events were [pause,move]. Replayed from a fresh game and reproduced.
reports.expected: Pause takes effect immediately and the rest of that tick's input is ignored, so the player stays at (1,1) and nothing moves.
